rationale: B02 flagged duplicate position keys at the CIK-quarter level, but the raw schedule itself discloses separate rows with duplicate or duplicate-looking descriptors. The Hiller example resolves to multiple source rows with same issuer/type/maturity but differing spreads or amounts, and table 31 rows 41-42 are two separate source rows with the same Hercules descriptor and values. Additional Dwyer rows in table 33 show repeated same issuer/type/rate/maturity with distinct principal, cost, and fair value amounts. The extraction is therefore preserving source-disclosed rows; the duplicate-key rule is over-scoped for filings that split positions into multiple source rows without a more granular tranche identifier.
